relationships.subject: pregnenolone sulphate
relationships.evidence_quote: All short pore loop TRPM3α variants (TRPM3α2-α6) were activated by the neurosteroid pregnenolone sulphate (PS) and by nifedipine, whereas the long pore loop variant TRPM3α1 was insensitive to either compound.

relationships.subject: clotrimazole
relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast, TRPM3α1 was robustly activated by clotrimazole

relationships.subject: isosakuranetin
relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast, a similar concentration of isosakuranetin induced only a partial inhibition (25%)

relationships.subject: mu opioid receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Clotrimazole-activated TRPM3α1 currents were largely insensitive to established TRPM3α2 antagonists and were only partially inhibited upon activation of the μ opioid receptor.

key_findings: Long-pore TRPM3α1 is not activated by pregnenolone sulphate or nifedipine but is activated by clotrimazole, unlike short-pore variants.
Only short-pore TRPM3 reads were found in DRG sensory neurons; pore loop length determines pharmacology.
